text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With only a few days left until the Aoba
Sho,
Mejiro Ardan arranges a meeting to
prepare.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And by a hair's breadth, it's Sakura
Chiyono O in
first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I enter my office to find Mejiro Ardan
intently
watching footage of past races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was studying how Chiyono O and
Yaeno have
been running lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They've been performing spectacularly
well in
their most recent races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So well, in fact, that I can hardly look
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've seen Mejiro
Ardan stress over other Umamusume like
this—especially with
her own race
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki
must really
mean a lot to her if she's this
worked up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will.
I'm certain they'll be entering
the
Japanese Derby.
choice_data_list: We'll end up facing each other aft...
We'll end up facing each other aft...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...However, the Aoba Sho is what matters now. As such, it follows that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My goal should be to surpass the finest
racer the
Mejiro family has ever known.
That, and nothing
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it appears that I may have gotten

sidetracked. Shall we begin our
meeting?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Mejiro Ardan turns off the TV.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then... the day of the Aoba Sho
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...That should do it. I'm ready to go at
any time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As always, I shall race at my current
best,
and without letting my pride get
the better of me.
choice_data_list: Let's deliver a result that leads ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then... I shall be off.
